issues.issue: The certification is of compliance with "Sections 7.16, and 7.37 of the Loan Agreement," but there is no Section 7.37; the covenant intended is Section 7.17. The certificate therefore certifies compliance with a provision that does not exist.

The Designated Account is identified as a Greater Bay Bank account in B-4 Partners' name, while Section 2.6(a) requires that from 60 days after the Closing Date "Wells Fargo shall be the only Cash Management Bank and all of the Cash Management Accounts shall be maintained at Wells Fargo." Whether the Designated Account survives that migration is not addressed.

Item 2 admits "the Subordinated Liens securing Approved Debt" as Permitted Liens once a Permitted Reorganization is implemented, while the "Subordinated Debt" definition, clause (a), describes such debt as "unsecured Indebtedness." The schedule contemplates security that the definition denies.

The schedule discloses an established practice of redeeming members' Interests and 50 pending redemption requests, whereas Section 7.10 prohibits Restricted Payments — which by definition include any "redemption, retirement, sinking fund or similar payment, purchase or other acquisition for value ... of any class of Stock in a Borrower" — except within narrow carve-outs. The disclosure and the operative covenant describe different regimes.
